text: Master Services Agreement: Terms regarding intellectual property indemnification and liability limitations for SaaS deployment.
Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement covering confidential technical trade secrets, proprietary algorithms, and source code disclosure.
Service Level Agreement guaranteeing 99.99% uptime availability for vector database search queries and cold disaster recovery.
Identity and Access Management: Enforcing multi-factor authentication, Role-Based Access Control, and session token rotation.
SOC 2 Type II compliance audit report detailing data encryption at rest using AES-256 and TLS 1.3 in transit.
Vulnerability management policy requiring static application security testing and dependency vulnerability scanning in CI/CD.
Zero-copy memory mapped file I/O paging mechanism reducing operating system memory buffer overhead for large vector files.
Write-Ahead Logging architecture with CRC32 checksums guaranteeing durability and automatic crash recovery upon power failure.
Hardware SIMD vectorization utilizing AVX2 and NEON registers to compute dot products and Euclidean distances across 1536 dimensions.
Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs organizing dense vectors into multi-layer proximity networks with logarithmic search complexity.
Okapi BM25 sparse lexical ranking incorporating inverse document frequency, document length normalization, and Roaring Bitmaps.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion algorithm combining dense semantic vector distances with sparse keyword frequencies into a unified score.
Model Context Protocol integration enabling autonomous agents like Claude Code, Antigravity, and Cursor to access semantic memory tools.
Graph-Augmented Generation retrieving multi-hop connected entities and relational knowledge to construct high-context LLM prompts.
Scalar Quantization SQ8 compressing float32 vector dimensions into 8-bit unsigned integers to reduce RAM footprint by 75 percent.
Enterprise billing schedule covering monthly recurring charges, vector storage quotas, and overage rates for high-throughput queries.
Automated invoice generation for cloud infrastructure compute units and reserved memory capacity.
Value Added Tax calculation rules for cross-border software licenses and digital service deliveries.
Pure Go database engine implementation without CGO dependencies for instant cross-compilation across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Embedded React 19 single page application compiled into the Go binary using embed filesystem and served on port 8383.
